name: contracts_finder-mcp
description: Contracts Finder (deals): search_postings, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: OCDS release package: documented parameters are publishedFrom, publishedTo (ISO 8601), stages (planning, tender, award, implementation), limit (1-100, default 100) and cursor. `stages=tender` is fixed so only tender-stage notices are listed; there is no keyword parameter, so `query`, `category` and `min_budget` are not sent (filter client-side). Paging is by cursor (`links.next`), which page/limit cannot carry: `page` is ignored and only the first `limit` releases are returned. `id` is the OCDS release `id` (notice GUID plus a version suffix) accepted by get_posting; the process `ocid` stays in raw (live check 2026-09-26: the documented Published/OCDS/Record/{ocid} answers 404 for every ocid, including the documentation's own sample); value/deadline/buyer come from the OCDS tender block documented on the Record page.

tools.name: get_posting
tools.description: GET Published/OCDS/Release/{id} ('Get the OCDS release package by the provided id'): `id` is the release id returned by search_postings (e.g. e2d9dc88-6503-4899-a4b0-76f0a5c96ffe-915593); releases[0] (tender{title, description, value, tenderPeriod}, buyer{name}, date) is mapped and the ocid stays in raw. Record/{ocid} is not used: on 2026-09-26 it answered 404 NotFound for every ocid, including the documentation's own sample. 404 when the release id is unknown.
